value.transport: NextGIS Web API and Collector resources
value.statement: QGIS publishers and the Android consumer preserve resource identity, type, schema, permissions, style/form composition and sync semantics; the Web GIS field-project catalog is the resource_group with keyname lisa for both Lisa and Belka apps; Collector resmeta.items.district is a single Latin district key that must match a token in the comma-separated feature district field (not exact string equality); SYNC_NONE layers compare the filtered server feature count and reload a full snapshot when it differs unless the server reports zero; export-only idqgs in a vector_only feature schema is included in mobile fields as LONG so the local schema matches NGW, but it does not make the layer Android-editable; Android verifies authoritative NGW class/geometry/fields against serialized config and physical SQLite, repairs serialized field or vector/PostGIS class drift without refill, and uses backup-gated atomic replacement only for physical/geometry mismatch; transient NGW or external-database availability never mutates resource identity or local data, and Android retries only failed pull layers without repeating successful ones. Published kvartal/vydel/vertexfeature_recent mobile configs may still carry local_vector_tiles; the current mobile preserves it as inert origin metadata, selects direct SQLite tiles for supported ordinary renderers and excludes hidden vectors from map identify. Schema, authoritative geometry/FID, editability and sync policy remain separately authoritative. The producer configs are unchanged; exact clean-source bytes/hashes are regression inputs, not business data. Canonical LISA scenario/resource references to the removed LocalVectorTileProvider require owner follow-up before end-to-end closure.
